parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, but official calls to exile trans people, a documented assault on an LGBT visitor, gay-panic acquittals, unsolved murders and zero hate-crime or discrimination recourse make outing low-severity socially but judicially tolerated violence.

Enforced sodomy statute, routine documented police extortion and pretext detention of gender-nonconforming people, plus prison abuse with nonconsensual exams outweigh recent protective court rulings that remain unimplemented; state actors are the exposure.

Parent regime supplies marker change, discrimination ban, transphobia sentencing enhancement and marriage equality; territory adds only isolation, stigma and no local care. Male-facility detention grey area and social concealment keep it below low-risk.

No criminalisation now, but no gender recognition, no discrimination law, constitutional marriage bar, dated police raids and a 69% poll backing criminalisation show hostile society with thin recourse; no recent documented violence.

Cross-dressing criminalised and enforced with a documented conviction; religious code adds lashing and stoning under a revocable moratorium; no document change possible. Universal-exposure trans-specific offence places it at the severe end.
